function normalizeCompany(name) {
  return (name || '').toUpperCase().replace(/[.,]+/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

function findCompany(name) {
  if (!name) return null;
  const norm = normalizeCompany(name);
  if (norm.length < 3) return null;
  if (LOOKUP[norm]) return LOOKUP[norm];
  const words = norm.replace(/[\-\/]+/g, ' ').split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length >= 4);
  for (const word of words) {
    if (word.length >= 5 && LOOKUP[word]) return LOOKUP[word];
  }
  if (words.length > 0 && words[0].length >= 5) {
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(LOOKUP)) {
      if (key.startsWith(words[0] + ' ') || key === words[0]) return val;
    }
  }
  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(LOOKUP)) {
    if (key.length >= 6 && (norm.includes(key) || key.includes(norm))) return val;
  }
  return null;
}

function looksLikeAddress(line) { return /^\d+\s/.test(line.trim()); }
function looksLikePhone(line) { return line.replace(/\D/g, '').length >= 10; }
function looksLikeEmail(line) { return /@/.test(line); }
function looksLikeCityStateZip(line) { return /,\s*[A-Z]{2}\s+\d{4,5}/.test(line); }
function looksLikeStateZip(line) { return /^[A-Z]{2}\s+\d{4,5}/.test(line.trim()); }

function cleanCity(raw) {
  if (!raw) return '';
  let s = String(raw).trim();
  s = s.replace(/[,\s]+[A-Za-z]{2}\s+\d{5}(-\d{4})?$/,'');
  s = s.replace(/[,\s]+\d{5}(-\d{4})?$/,'');
  s = s.replace(/[,\s]+[A-Za-z]{2}$/,'');
  s = s.replace(/,\s*$/,'');
  return s.trim();
}

function extractCity(line) {
  if (!line) return '';
  if (looksLikeStateZip(line)) return '';
  if (looksLikeCityStateZip(line)) return cleanCity(line.split(',')[0].trim());
  return cleanCity(line.trim());
}

function parseShipToBlock(lines) {
  const cleanLines = lines.filter(l => {
    const trimmed = l.trim();
    return trimmed.length > 0 && !looksLikePhone(trimmed) && !looksLikeEmail(trimmed);
  });
  if (cleanLines.length === 0) return { name: '', company: '', address: '', city: '' };

  let name = '', company = '', address = '', city = '';
  const line1Match = findCompany(cleanLines[0]);
  const line2Match = cleanLines.length > 1 ? findCompany(cleanLines[1]) : null;

  if (line1Match) {
    company = cleanLines[0];
    if (cleanLines.length > 1 && !looksLikeAddress(cleanLines[1])) {
      name = cleanLines[1];
      if (cleanLines.length > 2) address = cleanLines[2];
      if (cleanLines.length > 3) city = extractCity(cleanLines[3]);
      if (!city && cleanLines.length > 2 && looksLikeCityStateZip(cleanLines[2])) {
        city = extractCity(cleanLines[2]); address = '';
      }
    } else if (cleanLines.length > 1) {
      address = cleanLines[1];
      if (cleanLines.length > 2) city = extractCity(cleanLines[2]);
    }
  } else if (line2Match) {
    name = cleanLines[0]; company = cleanLines[1];
    if (cleanLines.length > 2) address = cleanLines[2];
    if (cleanLines.length > 3) city = extractCity(cleanLines[3]);
    if (!city && cleanLines.length > 2 && looksLikeCityStateZip(cleanLines[2])) {
      city = extractCity(cleanLines[2]); address = '';
    }
  } else {
    if (cleanLines.length >= 2 && looksLikeAddress(cleanLines[1])) {
      name = cleanLines[0]; address = cleanLines[1];
      if (cleanLines.length > 2) city = extractCity(cleanLines[2]);
    } else if (cleanLines.length >= 3 && looksLikeAddress(cleanLines[2])) {
      const corp = /\b(inc|llc|corp|ltd|group|partners|services|church|county|foundation|spa|med|construction|law|associates)\b/i;
      const hasCorpWord1 = corp.test(cleanLines[0]);
      const hasCorpWord2 = corp.test(cleanLines[1]);
      if (hasCorpWord1 && !hasCorpWord2) { company = cleanLines[0]; name = cleanLines[1]; }
      else if (hasCorpWord2 && !hasCorpWord1) { name = cleanLines[0]; company = cleanLines[1]; }
      else {
        const words1 = cleanLines[0].split(/\s+/).length;
        if (words1 <= 3 && !/\d/.test(cleanLines[0])) { name = cleanLines[0]; company = cleanLines[1]; }
        else { company = cleanLines[0]; name = cleanLines[1]; }
      }
      address = cleanLines[2];
      if (cleanLines.length > 3) city = extractCity(cleanLines[3]);
    } else if (cleanLines.length === 1) {
      name = cleanLines[0];
    } else {
      name = cleanLines[0];
      if (looksLikeCityStateZip(cleanLines[1])) city = extractCity(cleanLines[1]);
      else if (!looksLikeStateZip(cleanLines[1])) company = cleanLines[1];
      if (cleanLines.length > 2) address = cleanLines[2];
      if (cleanLines.length > 3) city = extractCity(cleanLines[3]);
    }
  }

  if (city && looksLikeStateZip(city)) city = '';
  if (!city && address && looksLikeCityStateZip(address)) {
    city = extractCity(address); address = '';
  }
  return { name, company, address: (address || '').trim(), city: cleanCity(city) };
}

const allComments = $input.all();
const allAppleItems = $('Filter Apple SKUs + Map Fields').all();
const results = [];

for (let i = 0; i < allComments.length; i++) {
  const commentsData = allComments[i].json;
  const comments = commentsData.comments || [];
  const prevData = allAppleItems[i].json;

  let euCompany = '';
  let euName = prevData._rs_contact_name || '';
  let euAddress = '';
  let euCity = '';
  let euCountry = 'US';
  let euSource = 'none';
  let customerType = 'EN';

  for (const comment of comments) {
    const body = (comment.body || '').trim();
    if (/(?:ship\s*to\/?\s*eu|ship\s*to|^eu\s*:)/im.test(body)) {
      const lines = body.split('\n').map(l => l.replace(/\t/g, ' ').trim()).filter(l => l);
      const startIdx = lines.findIndex(l => /(?:ship\s*to\/?\s*eu|ship\s*to|^eu\s*:)/i.test(l));
      if (startIdx >= 0 && lines.length > startIdx + 1) {
        const parsed = parseShipToBlock(lines.slice(startIdx + 1));
        if (parsed.name) euName = parsed.name;
        euCompany = parsed.company;
        euAddress = parsed.address;
        euCity = parsed.city;
        euSource = 'ticket_comment';
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  if (euCompany) {
    const match = findCompany(euCompany);
    if (match) {
      customerType = match.t;
      if (!euAddress) euAddress = match.a;
      if (!euCity) euCity = match.c;
      euCountry = match.co || 'US';
      euSource = 'ticket_comment+lookup';
    } else {
      customerType = '2L';
    }
  }

  if (!euCompany && prevData._rs_customer_name) {
    const custLower = prevData._rs_customer_name.toLowerCase();
    const intermediaries = ['markit', 'it devices', 'tachary', 'equipped', 'getupgraded', 'amazon', 'vtech', 'network & communication'];
    const isIntermediary = intermediaries.some(int => custLower.includes(int));

    if (!isIntermediary) {
      const match = findCompany(prevData._rs_customer_name);
      if (match) {
        euCompany = match.n;
        if (!euAddress) euAddress = match.a;
        if (!euCity) euCity = match.c;
        euCountry = match.co || 'US';
        customerType = match.t;
        euSource = 'lookup';
      } else {
        euCompany = prevData._rs_customer_name;
        if (!euAddress) euAddress = prevData._rs_customer_address;
        if (!euCity) euCity = cleanCity(prevData._rs_customer_city);
        customerType = '2L';
        euSource = 'rs_customer';
      }
     } else if (custLower.includes('equipped') || custLower.includes('getupgraded')) {
      customerType = 'EN';
      euSource = 'getupgraded_consumer';
    } else {
      // Intermediary (IT Devices, MarkIT, etc.) — populate raw RS data so you can review
      euCompany = prevData._rs_customer_name;
      if (!euAddress) euAddress = prevData._rs_customer_address;
      if (!euCity) euCity = cleanCity(prevData._rs_customer_city);
      customerType = '2L';
      euSource = 'needs_review';
    }
  }

  if (prevData.location === '2093771') {
    customerType = 'EN';
    if (euSource === 'none') euSource = 'getupgraded_consumer';
    if (euSource === 'ticket_comment' && !euCompany) euSource = 'getupgraded_consumer';
  }

  if (prevData._rs_has_gov) customerType = 'QW';

  euCity = cleanCity(euCity);
   if (euSource === 'getupgraded_consumer') euCountry = '';

  results.push({
    json: {
      location: prevData.location,
      apple_product: prevData.apple_product,
      sold_qty: prevData.sold_qty,
      returned_qty: prevData.returned_qty,
      invoice_number: prevData.invoice_number,
      invoice_date: prevData.invoice_date,
      eu_company: euCompany,
      eu_name: euName,
      eu_address: euAddress,
      eu_city: euCity,
      eu_country: euCountry,
      customer_type: customerType,
      _eu_source: euSource,
      _rs_customer_name: prevData._rs_customer_name,
      _rs_ticket_id: prevData._rs_ticket_id,
      _rs_invoice_id: prevData._rs_invoice_id,
      _rs_item_price: prevData._rs_item_price,
      _rs_item_name: prevData._rs_item_name,
      _needs_review: euSource === 'needs_review' || euSource === 'none'
    }
  });
}

return results;
